scope: OpenAI Responses, OpenAI Chat Completions, Gemini GenerateContent, Anthropic Messages only; all reachable source-defined structures, previews separated.

normalization.descriptions: Long source prose and examples omitted; structural keywords and reachable definitions retained.
normalization.openapi: All local component refs rewritten to $defs. No flattening of allOf/anyOf/oneOf.
normalization.gemini: Discovery converted to JSON Schema; explicitly Required descriptions become required; model moved to URL path. This is a derived schema, not an official JSON Schema release.
normalization.anthropic: SDK-based structural schema, not a published official OpenAPI. Pydantic export does not enforce every server-side semantic rule.
normalization.validation: Schema validity and examples are checked locally; lifecycle and model support require separate checks.

openai_normalizations.reason: Official EasyInputMessage and Item/InputMessage branches overlap for documented message input; strict oneOf rejects valid requests.
